notes.title: First major Playtest Patch
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless Mode now scales until round 40 (Score: 1e30)
[*] Added Button to move all Letters from Center to hand (Hold B/Circle on Controller)
[*] Added Animation when Letter added to Deck
[*] Balancing Adjustments for Stickers & Marks
[*] Adjusted Font to better distinct Letters D and O
[*] Added Sound Cue when unlocking a Path
[*] Added Word Score & Animation for Round Score
[*] Increased Base volume of Music
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in a Round Loss when having 0 cards in Hand & Deck, despite having reached the Round Score
[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in "NONE" Tiles appearing in Hand
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed rerolling the Shop with insufficient Money
[*] Fixed an issue that made tooltips not disappear properly when hovering over them
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed to change Language within the round
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Glyphs to be bought via Drag&Drop
[/list]

[b]Loca[/b]
[list]
[*] Added French Language Support
[*] Added Spanish Language Support
[*] Slight tweaks for English and German Loca
[/list]
